stories.title: Two Historic USA Fuel Records Fall

stories.title: OMV Petrom invests 115-million euros in modernizing Petrobrazi refinery’s electrical infrastructure
stories.summary: The new infrastructure will support both the refinery’s operations and the activities of future HVO, SAF and green-hydrogen production units.

stories.title: Bayer, Neste close commercial agreement to jointly scale newgold® winter canola for biofuels production
stories.summary: The commitment aims to support the growth of winter canola in the Southern Great Plains of the U.S. as a feedstock for renewable diesel and SAF.

stories.title: Synhelion advances scale up with large-scale synthetic fuel project in Morocco
stories.summary: The facility, to be located in Morocco’s Tan-Tan province in the region of Guelmim-Oued Noun, is planned to produce 100,000 tons of renewable fuel per year.

stories.title: United States on track for record crude oil production in 2026
stories.summary: We forecast U.S. crude oil production will average 13.8 million barrels per day (b/d) in 2026, surpassing the previous record of 13.7 million b/d set in 2025, in our latest Short-Term Energy Outlook (STEO).

stories.title: McDermott Wins Contract for Eni's Cronos Project offshore Cyprus
stories.summary: The Houston-based company received a 'substantial' contract from Eni for Cyprus' first hydrocarbon development.

stories.title: TotalEnergies Makes New Discovery offshore Angola
